purpose: Reusable theme vocabulary for correspondence; themes grant no authority, evidence status or contact eligibility.

themes.description: Safe, accountable healthcare processes and prevention of harm.
Competent, impartial review with conflicts screened and findings distinguished from allegations.
Equal access, reasonable accommodations and accessible services.
Nondiscrimination, equitable treatment and civil-rights processes.
Access to appropriate coordinated care and continuity during transitions.
Accurate records, preservation, accessible correction and provenance.
Practical assistance, confidential caregiver navigation and family support.
Appropriate community services, voluntary support and referral.
Clinical ethics, professional responsibility and boundaries of authority.
Documented oversight, responsible process improvement and public accountability.
Accessible written communication, acknowledgment and clear next steps.
Voluntary pastoral care and spiritual support, independent of complaint adjudication.
